epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce bypassed quality controls to 0 incidents
requirements: R1: Prevent test bypassing by removing -DskipTests from Dockerfiles and failing the build if tests are skipped.
R2: Prevent fake reviews by validating reasoning in PR approvals and blocking merge if reasoning is missing or generic.

slices.title: Patch Dockerfiles and enforce PR review validation
slices.jtbd: When implementing quality control enforcement for this epic, I want to remove test skipping and add review validation, so that deliberate quality control bypassing is prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Docker build, When it executes, Then tests are run and the build fails if -DskipTests is present.
Given a PR approval, When it is submitted, Then it is rejected unless it contains substantive reasoning.
Given a quality control validation test, When a fake approval or test skip is attempted, Then the CI pipeline explicitly blocks the action, verifying our QA coverage.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test execution and 100% genuine PR approvals
slices.dod: All Dockerfiles patched to remove test skips, PR review validation rules enforced, and CI tests pass.

epics.title: Goal-Question-Metric Telemetry for Code Integrity
epics.jtbd: When assessing the development pipeline, I want to measure test execution rates and review depth, so that I know if our quality control gates are effective.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Defect escape rate due to bypassed CI gates
requirements: R1: Goal: Ensure quality control gates are effective. Questions: Are tests running consistently? Are reviews substantive? Metrics: Test execution rate per build and average word count of review reasoning.

slices.title: Instrument GQM telemetry for CI and PR reviews
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for this epic, I want to capture test execution and review depth metrics, so that the GQM questions can be answered.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a completed CI build, When metrics are collected, Then the test execution rate is recorded.
Given a PR approval, When it is submitted, Then the length of the reasoning is logged.
Given a telemetry validation test, When metrics are queried, Then the expected values for the recent build and PR are returned, verifying our QA coverage.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Metric coverage of builds and PRs reaches 100%
slices.dod: GQM telemetry instrumented, tests passed, and metrics verified.
